why_this_slot.text: Best modeled placement for Trent Grisham is slot #3 (4.837 expected team runs/game).
Slots #3, #2, #6, #4, #1, #5, #7, #8 are within 0.01 runs/game of each other — essentially equivalent under the model’s operational band.
Primary actual slot #1 ranks 5 of 9; estimated placement opportunity vs best is +0.004 R/G.
Slot #3 yields 4.50 expected PA/game vs 4.72 at primary slot #1. Batting order changes both game states and plate appearances.
